facts.fact: The Minister of the Interior and Decentralisation told the Senate on 7 August 2026 that the rollout of SIFEC was imminent; Brazzaville Insider, citing ACI, describes it as a plan on the verge of deployment and not a system in use.

According to the Interior minister on 7 August 2026, SIFEC would cover birth, marriage and death certificates, dematerialising and centralising the records; this is the stated scope of a platform not yet rolled out.

The Minister of the Interior and Decentralisation presented SIFEC to the Senate on 7 August 2026 as his ministry's answer to the sale of civil status papers by officials in town halls, districts and urban communities.
